items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: You saw anybody like the T.O.s or Locke, or nobody you ever saw? No, no I never.

ctx.x: You never had, never played on anything like that?
You saw anybody like the T.O.s or Locke, or nobody you ever saw? No, no I never.
Before their time I guess too.
